items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I forgot to mention that I knew Johnny Hartsfield out in Denver.

ctx.x: Do you remember what it was?

Yeah, I think Taps Miller or something like that. But I really didn't remember the date. But there's a whole lot of things I guess I don't remember. I forgot to mention that I knew Johnny Hartsfield out in Denver. Do you know Johnny?
I've seen pictures of him playing on 52nd Street. Tenor player.
